answer: Pay each epoch's reward in proportion to coins an agent keeps locked, not per head. Then splitting one vault across a hundred fake accounts earns exactly what the single vault would have, so clones add nothing but upkeep. Like a raven that hides its food in many spots, the farm still holds the same amount; it just spends more effort guarding it. Honest newcomers start small, but every voyage from one epoch to the next grows their share fairly, because only real stake counts.
